title: Work in a second browser profile's workspace, toggle a setting, reload the config, relaunch, then return to the first profile and undo the setting
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one workspace in the default browser profile, one terminal tab
the tag's daemon keeps running while the app quits, so the sessions are kept

steps.note: a second browser profile, made the way the browserProfile action fixture makes it (oracle/action_fixtures/browser_profile.py)
a workspace whose browser tabs use the scratch profile
Select Workspace 2: the scratch profile's workspace is shown
Toggle Sidebar Animations: a reversible write of one key to the private cmux-next.json; motion stays off under the bench's ui.animations.enabled=false
Reload Configuration: the file holds the toggled key, so the effective settings do not change

expect.noReceiptReason: a relaunch runs no action; the restored workspaces and the settings read from the file are its result

steps.note: the runner quits the app it started with Quit and Keep Sessions (quitKeepSessions), then launches the same tag on the same state root and config file
closes the shown workspace, the scratch profile's; the selection returns to the first workspace
the setting goes back to its launch value

invariants: the settings facet at toggled equals the one after toggle-setting: Reload Configuration reads back the key the toggle wrote
the settings facet at relaunched equals the one at toggled: the setting survived the relaunch, and the scratch profile's workspace came back selected
the first workspace and its tabs are the same at launched, toggled, relaunched and returned: work in the scratch profile changes none of them
the settings facet at returned equals the one at launched: the setting is back and nothing else leaked into the config
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: each tab's browser profile: the tabs facet has no profile field, so scoping is checked through the first workspace's tabs staying the same
Classic's cmux.json: the case runs only the cmux-next app and its private cmux-next.json
deleting the scratch profile: browserProfile.delete is person-only, so it stays in the case's private state root
